name: Standing time limit for uploading to the portal

attrs.quote: within thirty days from the date of such invoice, failing which the same shall not be treated as an invoice
attrs.note: Absent: no standing limit in 68/2019, 69/2019, 13/2020 or its amendments to 04/2026, 02/2020, 60/2020, 72/2020, 14/2022 or 05/2026. 73/2020 set thirty days only for invoices of 1 to 31 October 2020 not prepared under rule 48(4).
